findings.detail: Benchmarks whether language-model-generated molecules resemble BioTransformer products rather than predicting products for the supplied parent structure.
Filters generated structures by neutral exact mass within a ppm window but does not calculate and match the common adduct m/z values requested by the query.
Detects, aligns, and quantifies LC-MS features from raw data but does not export the requested per-feature MS2 spectra.
Links observed accurate-mass features to parent compounds and reaction rules but does not consolidate the stage's MS/MS-matched ranked hits.
